Landscape, animal and event photography

Light, found in quiet places.

A small, unhurried studio for people who would rather wait for the right light than chase the next shot.

Sample photographs (CC0) by Agnes Monkelbaan, Jörg Braukmann and Bernard Gagnon. Credits

We photograph the hour before everyone else arrives, and the minute after they leave.

Vale & Ember is an imagined two-person studio working between coast and mountain. Our sessions are slow by design: a long walk, a lot of listening, and then a few frames we are proud of.

Vale & Ember is fictional. The photographs on this website are sample images by other photographers, credited on every enlarged view and on the Credits page.

The studio

Patient by nature

We work with very little equipment and a lot of time. Before a session we walk the place, watch where the light falls and talk about what matters to you. After it, we edit quietly and deliver a small, considered set rather than hundreds of near-duplicates.
